scope: 118 element identities and layout; neutral first-20 configurations; selected teaching ions only

conventions.names: IUPAC spellings aluminium, caesium, sulfur; allow aluminum/cesium/sulphur only as search aliases
conventions.group: IUPAC numbers 1–18; null for all detached La–Lu and Ac–Lr entries; null is not group zero
conventions.block: s/p/d for unambiguous displayed main-body assignments; null for the entire detached series rather than asserting a disputed boundary or a 15-element f block
conventions.display_region: Detached lanthanoid_series and actinoid_series are layout regions, not a claim that every entry has differentiating f electron
conventions.display_coordinates: 18-column classroom layout; main rows 1–7; detached rows 8–9 columns 3–17; placeholders at period 6/7 group 3 link to 57–71 / 89–103, not extra elements
conventions.hydrogen: group 1 placement; nonmetal, not an alkali metal
conventions.charge: signed integer in units of elementary charge; distinct from atom multiplicity and oxidation state
conventions.unknown: null or absent means intentionally not supplied, never zero
conventions.license_note: Original schema, examples and validation prose. Minimal factual transcription with source attribution; no source images, prose passages or full third-party database copied. Publisher-specific licenses remain with sources. Audit their terms before importing any additional bulk data.
